rules.continuousFloor: escaped and all continuous quantities available and quarter-tolerance stable
rules.rayInputs: camera/pixel strata inherit stratum.inputs; rayFor(stratum.camera, ...case.pixel, 1280, 720) passes through (i + 0.5, j + 0.5); case.inputs contains overrides; absent expected reason/subreason means null; steps are not compared
rules.screen: each relevant effective binary32 input individually nextDown/nextUp, including all four C and all four q0 components

overview.eligibility: same resolved status; positive hits have t > 0; depth difference recorded, never screened
overview.surfaceBearing: bulbs and quaternion |kappa| <= 0.5 except C = (2,0,0,0); no hit floor does not assert an empty slice

rules.referenceConvergence: overview: same resolved status only; detail ladder: same resolved status and relative positive-hit depth delta <= 1e-3
rules.anchorSelection: central seed ray at overview azimuth and opposite azimuth; no adaptive replacement
rules.qualification: CPU preparation only; mandatory inconclusive blocks GPU qualification; no product validation is registered

convergence.rule: both approximate hit; deltaT <= 1e-3 * largest ladder distance (0.1); each ladder row rechecks deltaT <= 1e-3 * distance
